Class ElitistReplacement<C extends GASolution<C>>

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.ga.triimage.ElitistReplacement<C>
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReplacementOperator<C>
public final class ElitistReplacement<C extends GASolution<C>> extends Object implements ReplacementOperator<C>
Elitist replacement operator for genetic algorithms. This operator preserves a specified number of the best individuals (eliteCount) from the current population and fills the rest of the next generation with offspring. The elite individuals are selected based on their fitness, ensuring that the best solutions are retained across generations.

    • replace

      public List<C> replace(List<C> population, List<C> offspring, double[] popFitness, double[] offFitness, Random rng)
      Description copied from interface: ReplacementOperator
      Form the next generation from the current population and its offspring. Fitness arrays are aligned with their corresponding lists. The returned ordering is unrestricted, but its size must equal the current population.
      Specified by:
      replace in interface ReplacementOperator<C extends GASolution<C>>
      Parameters:
      population - current population
      offspring - newly created offspring
      popFitness - current-population fitness values
      offFitness - offspring fitness values
      rng - source of randomness
      Returns:
      complete next generation
